invariants.rationale: The method is not expected to handle null clusteringPlan, so this is likely an implicit precondition.
The method expects a valid schema to define the data, so null schema is likely invalid.
The clustering instant time should be a valid, non-empty string to identify the clustering operation.
The method directly calls getInputGroups() on clusteringPlan, so non-null result is expected.
The method uses clusteringPlan.getStrategy() to retrieve the strategy parameters, so it should not be null.
